result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' row are exact duplicates: same 'Green Bowl Poké' name, same food image, same '15–25 min' badge, and same '€0.90 delivery' price. This appears to be duplicated or placeholder data rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each carousel card represents a unique restaurant with its own name, image, and delivery details; remove or replace the duplicated entry.

issues.description: The two identical poké images use a flat light-gray placeholder-style background while neighboring cards (e.g., Smash Bros burger) use rich photographic backgrounds, making the row look inconsistent and unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent, high-quality restaurant imagery across all cards in the carousel.
